notes:
# Waymark 0.5.1

- Added 1,124 Aion Dex reference spawn positions across 62 pet/NPC/map links, matched by numeric NPC ID. Existing higher-precision coordinates are kept when sources agree.
- Pet markers now identify compact farming pockets instead of a single broad regional anchor. Each center is an actual spawn reference; saved regional route IDs continue to resolve to the largest mapped pocket in that area.
- Default map and minimap presentation uses pocket centers and selected-group outlines. Display → Spawn dots restores individual positions and remembers the choice.
- Selected farming areas show group size, source and review date. Static density is not a measured farming-rate recommendation; live mobs, altitude and respawn are not inferred.
